symbols.name: butterfly layer
symbols.meaning: The simultaneous butterfly layer, the two-point butterfly applied at once to one selected address bit of every chunk.
symbols.quote: The simultaneous butterfly layer $H_0$ applies a two-point butterfly to one selected address bit of every chunk in one pass.

symbols.name: chunk count
symbols.meaning: The number of equal-width address chunks on which the layer acts, each with one selected bit.
symbols.quote: The layer is the map $H_0(u,v)=\bigl((u+v)/2,(u-v)/2\bigr)$ applied at once to one selected bit of each of $d$ equal-width chunks, where $d$ is the number of chunks, each with its selected bit at a common offset from the least significant end.

symbols.name: record length
symbols.meaning: The number of complex coefficients in a polynomial record.
symbols.quote: Each address holds a polynomial record of $r$ complex coefficients, where $r$ is the number of complex coefficients in a record.

symbols.name: cost exponent
symbols.meaning: A fixed exponent below one that sets the layer's cost bound.

relations.quote: Intermediate values in the layer are exact [Gaussian dyadic numbers](gaussian-dyadic.md), whose real and imaginary parts have power-of-two denominators.
The layer acts on arrays stored in the [Frame of a vertex](frame.md) on each wire.

Applying $H_0$ to all $d$ selected bits is the [Tensor product](tensor-product.md) of the $d$ single-bit butterflies, so the result equals applying them one at a time in any order, and the other address bits are unchanged.
